title: Titration and neutralizing antibody quantification by focus forming assay for Powassan virus
protocol: Autoclave a 1 L glass bottle, 10 g methylcellulose, and a large stir bar prior to preparation.
Add 500 mL of hot autoclaved Millipore water to the bottle containing methylcellulose and a large stir bar in a tissue culture hood.
Stir on a hotplate set between medium/high until methylcellulose is in solution (1–4 h).
Aliquot cooled 2% methylcellulose into 50 mL conical tubes slowly.
Store aliquoted 2% methylcellulose at 4°C until further use in the assay, which will require bringing the methylcellulose to room temperature.
Prepare 5× FFA Staining buffer according to tables found in materials and equipment: To 250 mL of 10× PBS, add 250 mL of Millipore water and 2.5 g of Saponin.
Stir until dissolved, then sterile filter the mixture.
Store the prepared staining buffer at 4°C until the day of the assay.
Prepare 1× FFA Wash buffer by mixing: To 9 L of Millipore water, add 1 L of 10× PBS and 5 mL Triton X-100.
Prepare media for BHK cells by mixing: To 500 mL of 5% DMEM, add 5 mL HEPES solution and 25 mL Fetal Bovine Serum (FBS).
Store the prepared media at 4°C until further use.
Add 2.5 × 10^4 cells per well to a tissue culture treated 96-well plate in 100 μL of growth media per well.
Incubate overnight at 37°C with 5% CO2.
Examine cells under a light microscope the day of the assay to ensure approximately 90% confluence.

Prepare 10-fold serial dilutions of the sample containing virus by adding 20 μL of sample to 180 μL of growth media in a 96-well round bottom plate, performed in duplicate or triplicate with at least one column including a ‘mock’ infected PBS control.
Remove media from 96-well flat bottom plate containing BHKs.
Add 100 μL per well of serially diluted samples in growth media to the 96-well flat bottom plate containing BHKs.
Incubate at 37°C with 5% CO2 for 1 hour without shaking.
During incubation, mix one part 2% methylcellulose with one part growth media on a rocker at room temperature with gentle agitation.
Add 125 μL per well of diluted methylcellulose in growth media to the flat bottom plate containing BHKs and serially diluted samples.
Incubate for 24 hours without shaking at 37°C, 5% CO2.
Prepare 5% paraformaldehyde by diluting 20% electron microscopy grade PFA four-fold in 1× PBS.
Fix cells with 5% paraformaldehyde by adding 50 μL per well and incubate at room temperature for 30–60 min.
Wash cells gently three times with 150 μL per well of 1× PBS.
Add 150 μL per well of 1× FFA Wash buffer and let sit for 5–10 min at room temperature.
Remove plates from BSL-3 containment.
Prepare 1× FFA Staining buffer by diluting 5× FFA Staining buffer five-fold in Millipore water.
Remove Wash buffer and add primary antibody diluted 3:10,000 in 1× FFA Staining buffer (50 μL per well).
Incubate at room temperature for 1.5–2 h with gentle agitation on an orbital shaker or overnight at 4°C without shaking.
Wash three times with 1× FFA Wash buffer (150 μL per well).
Remove wash buffer and add secondary antibody diluted 1:5,000 in 1× FFA staining buffer (50 μL per well).
Incubate at room temperature for 2–3 hours.
Wash three times with 1× FFA wash buffer (150 μL per well).
Remove wash buffer and add Trueblue substrate (50 μL per well).
Incubate in the dark without shaking for 15-20 minutes until spots are fully defined with minimal background.
Flick off the substrate and wash twice with 200 μL/well of cool Millipore water to quench the reaction.
Tap on a paper towel to remove water and count or image within 15–30 minutes of quenching for best counting results.
Ensure the correct filepath and plate setting under ‘Dashboard’.
Use the ’96 well BD Falcon’ setting for most FFAs.
Load and name the plate.
Start the scan, confirm that the CTL machine can correctly identify the A1, A12, and H1 wells.
Allow images to be collected during the scan.
Return to the CTL Switchboard after the scan has completed.
Select the ‘Count’ function.
Select ‘SmartCount’.
Find the file folder containing the plate that was just scanned/imaged.
Load the plate(s) into the autocount queue.
Select a few wells with clear, distinct foci.
Adjust the parameters of the spot count, giving special consideration to the appropriate gate size, background balance, and spot separation.
Use a manually counted well or series of wells if necessary to adjust parameters.
Start the autocount once the appropriate parameters are selected.
Return to the CTL Switchboard after the autocount has completed.
Select the ‘Quality Control’ function.
Find the file folder containing the plate that was just counted.
Load the plate(s) into the quality queue.
Use quality control functions of the CTL Elispot to manually correct aberrant counts and remove false spots/hits.
Re-count wells with different parameters if necessary, using the same method as for the original autocount.
